title: Threads Silver SocialPost event v1
description: Kafka transport envelope for an unchanged canonical Silver SocialPost observation. Payload uses the existing Silver contract. Implementations additionally enforce source/run_id/record_id agreement with payload and deterministic event identity. Replay can duplicate events; event identity is separate from Kafka offsets and entity identity.

event_id.description: SHA-256 of compact UTF-8 JSON array [run_id, record_id]. Stable for repeated publication of the same observation, independent of emitted_at.

record_id.description: Preserved Silver entity identity, also used as the Kafka UTF-8 message key.

emitted_at.description: UTC event creation time, separate from collection and normalization times.
